about: The Linux rows for local container tests (just linux-test, tools/linux-test.js) and, later, the CI matrix (parity T.1). One row per distribution the Linux release needs (R-1), its newest release for now (owner, 2026-11-01); each provider PR adds the oldest supported release (D-c). Every image is pinned by tag and digest; Renovate updates them behind the release-age gate. mise is the version the CI workflows pin, checked by its release's sha256.

gate_exception.why: Tumbleweed's only multi-arch image is latest, rebuilt daily; its dated snapshots that pass the gate have no arm64 build. This digest was pushed 2026-11-01T12:16Z and clears the 3-day gate on its own on 2026-11-04.
